# Package-version comparator oracle — a fixed seed corpus.
#
# Captured from real interpreters, byte-identical on both:
#   tclsh8.6  (Tcl 8.6.14)
#   tclsh9.0  (Tcl 9.0.4)
#
# Generated by scripts/dev/gen-package-version-oracle.tcl (kept in-repo so a
# reviewer can re-run it):
#
#   tclsh8.6 scripts/dev/gen-package-version-oracle.tcl version
#   tclsh9.0 scripts/dev/gen-package-version-oracle.tcl version
#
# The `bigs` grid in that script covers numeric components past 32-bit, past
# i64, past u64, and forty digits wide, plus leading-zero spellings — C Tcl
# compares digit strings by length-then-lexicographic order after stripping
# leading zeros, so it is exact at every width and the port must be too
# (issue #1090 review, finding 2).
#
# Row formats (tab-separated):
#   vcompare          V1  V2   -1|0|1
#   vsatisfies        V   REQ  0|1
#   malformed-version V        1 (interpreter raised) | 0 (accepted)
#   malformed-req     REQ RC   RESULT-when-RC-is-0
#
# `malformed-*` rows pin the inputs the interpreter *rejects*: the port has no
# error channel, so it answers `false` where the interpreter raises, and the
# test asserts that mapping rather than a bare "does not panic".
